items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 200:1
items.html: Every lower one is born and comes out in the mouth of the head of its upper one, and descends from there and clothes the upper one from outside. And it is discerned that the essence of the light of the lower one remains in the upper one, and only the aspect of a branch of it reaches the lower one. (Item 6).
